_about: dev-decide settings for this repository. Edit any value and save; changes apply on the next run. Every setting is listed here with its default, and '_help' below says what each one does. Delete a setting to get its default back. Keys starting with '_' are notes and are ignored. Your personal settings in ~/.claude/dev-decide.json are overridden by any setting written here.

_help.notes: Plain-English facts about this project that are sent to Claude with each question, e.g. 'We deploy on weekdays only'. Up to 10 are used.
_help.critical_paths: Minimum risk score (1-5) for changes touching certain files. Example: {"src/payments/**": 4, "infra/**": {"risk": 3}}. ** matches any folder depth, * one path segment.
_help.thresholds: Minimum confidence (0-1) before an answer is accepted instead of flagged with '?' for a human. 'default' applies to everything; add a decision name to override it, e.g. "severity": 0.7.
_help.backend: Which model answers what stays unsure. 'auto' (Claude: the API if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, else your Claude Code sign-in), 'api', 'cli', 'openai' (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: OpenAI, Azure, Groq, Together, OpenRouter, Mistral, DeepSeek, or a local Ollama, LM Studio or vLLM; key in OPENAI_API_KEY, endpoint in OPENAI_BASE_URL), 'gemini' (GEMINI_API_KEY), 'command' (another model CLI named in DEV_DECIDE_COMMAND, e.g. ["ollama", "run", "{model}"]; the prompt goes in on stdin), or 'none' (local answers only). Env DEV_DECIDE_BACKEND overrides. For safety, an endpoint (openai.base_url, gemini.base_url), openai.key_env and command are read only from your personal ~/.claude/dev-decide.json or the environment, never from this file.
_help.model: Which model answers, per backend: 'cli' is the name used with Claude Code (haiku, sonnet, opus), 'api' the API model id; add 'openai', 'gemini' or 'command' with your provider's model name (they have no default). Env DEV_DECIDE_MODEL_<BACKEND> (e.g. DEV_DECIDE_MODEL_OPENAI), then DEV_DECIDE_MODEL, override it.
_help.effort: How hard Claude thinks per question when using Claude Code: 'low' (fast, cheap), or higher levels, or 'default'.
_help.cache: true: remember identical requests so the same question is answered instantly and free.
_help.cache_ttl_hours: How long a remembered answer stays valid, in hours.
_help.capture: Whether to keep a hashed numeric fingerprint of each input so local models can learn from it. 'hashed' keeps no readable text; 'off' disables it.
_help.log: true: write each decision (answers and confidence only, never your input text) to .claude/dev-decide/log.jsonl.
_help.router_hook: The per-prompt routing hint. enabled: turn it off with false. min_confidence / min_margin: how clear a match must be before a hint is added. builtins: also suggest Claude Code's built-in agents.
_help.decision_graph: The decision graph: which agent or skill was suggested for which kind of task, what Claude really used, and how long each step took. Open http://127.0.0.1:47321/graph or run /dev-decide-graph. Kept on this machine only (~/.claude/dev-decide/traces). enabled: false stops recording. keep_days: how long events are kept. prompt_chars: how much of each prompt is kept so you can tell requests apart (the first 40 characters, keys and tokens masked; 0 keeps none).
_help.routes: Which agents and skills 'route' can choose from. builtins: include Claude Code's built-in agents. exclude: names to never suggest. extra: your own entries, each {"name": "", "kind": "agent", "description": ""}.
_help.presets: Your own questions. Add under choose/score/verify, e.g. {"choose": {"service": {"options": ["web", "api", "worker"]}}}.
_help.bundles: Named groups of questions, e.g. {"release": ["risk", "breaking_change"]}. Use as /dev-decide release :: DIFF.
_help.gates: Pass/review/block rules for a bundle. Example: {"release": {"requires": ["risk"], "block": ["risk.score >= 4.5"], "review": ["risk.score >= 3.5"]}}.
_help.learning: How dev-decide improves from use. enabled: false turns learning off (env DEV_DECIDE_LEARNING=0 also does). target: accuracy local answers must reach before they are trusted. audit_rate / audits_per_day: how many local answers Claude double-checks (costs a little). keep_text and audit_ttl_days: how long input text is kept before deletion. The rest are tuning knobs; leave them unless you know why.
_help.escalate: Hard cases are re-asked to a stronger model. enabled: false turns it off (env DEV_DECIDE_ESCALATE=0 also does). below: confidence under which to escalate. per_day: daily cap on stronger-model calls. presets: which decisions may escalate. cli / api name the stronger Claude; add openai, gemini or command with a stronger model of that provider, or those backends never escalate (env DEV_DECIDE_STRONG_MODEL_<BACKEND> also works).
_help.calibration: Filled in automatically by 'calibrate.py' from your own corrected answers. Leave it empty unless you ran that.
